BrochureContent.Content:
Nestled on a quiet horseshoe in the highly sought after Birches Close, number 35 is a delightful bright, deceptively spacious four bedroom semi detached property that enjoys a sunny south westerly orientation. Fronting onto a large green area this beautifully presented residence holds instant kerb appeal with attractive timber fencing bordering a manicured front lawn with tarmac drive leading up to the front door. 
On entering the property, the house proud nature of the current owners shines through with an inviting entrance hall greeting you on arrival. Well proportioned rooms enjoy excellent natural light from the numerous large window openings complementing the most appealing décor on offer. Flair and design are evident throughout this beautiful family home and it is easy to tell that it has been lovingly cared for over the years, this coupled with a bright and airy interior is sure to delight prospective purchasers..
Located off the entrance hall one will find a fabulous front reception with large bay style window opening that gives the room depth and character, interlinking double doors allow the accommodation to flow effortlessly to a magnificent open plan themed room to the rear of the property comfortably accommodating a fully fitted kitchen, dining and recreational areas. The country style fitted kitchen is in keeping with the tasteful décor on offer and will easily meet the demands of a growing family. Sliding patio doors invite you out to the sunny south west facing private walled garden. A good sized utility and guest WC complete the ground floor accommodation. At first floor level the property boasts four fine size bedrooms, with master ensuite and a family bathroom. Both bathroom suites are exquisite, adding to number 35's appeal. This beautiful family home is sure to tick a lot of boxes and appeal to a wide audience of buyers.

Outside, the property boasts generous lawn gardens to the front and rear. The sunny south west facing rear garden is a delight to behold and acts as an extra room during the warmer months. A substantial steel shed is located to one side of the garden, making for an ideal workshop as well an excellent outdoor storage facility. The shed is also plumbed and serviced with electricity giving it a wide range of uses depending on the discerning buyers requirements.

The highly regarded The Birches Close Estate enjoys a highly convenient location. Located just off the Galway Road the property is within easy walking distance to Tuam Town with a wealth of amenities to hand, boasting a wide selection of shops, cafes, restaurants, bars, leisure facilities, a wonderful public park and excellent schools. Bus Eireann, Burke's Bus and GoBus service the area providing excellent services to Galway and beyond; the access to the M17 motorway is only minutes away making commuting hassle free.

Be sure to contact our office today to avoid disappointment!!

Landing:

Another fine size bright double bedroom also located to the rear of the property enjoying a calming pastel green colour palette with feature woodland wall that ties in naturally with the attractive oak effect laminate flooring; large window opening fill the room with light and also offers a pleasant outlook to the rear garden.

Outside:

Extensive front lawn garden bordered with attractive timber fencing bound by planting beds to the front and one side; large tarmac driveway offers excellent off street parking; good side access leads to the rear garden; this sunny south west facing walled rear garden enjoys a large lawn garden with spacious patio area embracing the property. A substantial steel storage shed is serviced with water and electricity and features a concrete base making for another excellent addition to the property, the shed is an ideal workshop, potting shed and spacious storage unit. The concrete base continues out from the shed and connects with the large patio area, this large concrete base lends itself well for the Pergola if desired, with fitted drains already in place. Clever fitted timber bin storage unit; a pleasant raised timber planting area; white wash walls are further complemented by an attractive stained timber fence extension adding to the gardens privacy; well staged outdoor lighting gives this outdoor space a different look at night; outdoor condenser oil burner; outdoor tap.
